state_at_freeze: 150 judgments with pair-specific rationales completed; keys not joined and rates not calculated
anchor_reading: All A fragments were read in the C6 review. Before reusing that reading, byte-identical A fragments across C4/C5/C6 were verified for all 50 positions. Every B fragment was read individually; judgments were not transferred between different pairs.
blinding: Not fully blind or independent; reviewer knew the study context and benchmark results. No audit_key.csv was opened during labeling.
interval_interpretation: Wilson intervals quantify sampling uncertainty only; not AI-review accuracy or bias.
